verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is an SDK/API invoked programmatically from Workers code (sandbox.exec, writeFile, sessions, git automation, CI/CD explicitly listed as a use case), which makes it naturally scriptable and headless-friendly for automation pipelines. However, there is no first-party CLI, CI recipe, GitHub Actions example, or documented non-interactive automation workflow, and community discussion raises open questions about idle-timeout/auto-destroy behavior and boot latency relevant to CI use. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD integration guide or examples, official CLI for headless invocation outside Workers runtime, documented auto-cleanup/idle-timeout controls for ephemeral CI runs, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
